name: EMERA INCORPORATED
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

ads_ratio.source: Emera Inc. Form 40-F / FY2025 reporting: the Corporation's common shares are listed directly on the TSX and NYSE under the symbol EMA (every earnings release header reads TSX/NYSE: EMA); there is no depositary or ADS program — the NYSE line is the same common shares. The FY2025 statements' EPS note (Note 13) denominator — weighted average diluted shares 299.7M — matches the engine's shares_diluted_latest exactly, confirming filed per-share figures and the NYSE price are on the same share basis.
ads_ratio.reason: Direct-listed ordinary (common) shares on both exchanges, so per-share figures from the filings and the NYSE price are on the same share basis: ratio 1.0.

fx_conversion.source: frankfurter.app — ECB reference rates (closest business day to each period end)

f_subtype_basis: sum of the last 3 fiscal years (the median window)

overrides_applied.source: Emera Inc. FY2025 consolidated financial statements (filed as Exhibit 99.3 to the Form 40-F for the year ended Dec 31, 2025, filed 2026-02-23, accession 0001193125-26-062876), Note 32 Stock-Based Compensation: compensation cost recognized FY2025 — ECSPP C$3M + stock options C$3M + employee/director DSUs C$29M + PSU plan C$31M + RSU plan C$23M = C$89M (CAD, as filed; the engine FX-converts at period-end rates).
overrides_applied.reason: EDGAR companyfacts carries no SBC expense figure for Emera under any candidate tag the engine reads (ShareBasedCompensation, AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense, ifrs AdjustmentsForSharebasedPayments) for FY2023-2025 — sbc_tag is blank for every year 2016-2025 — so the v5 data gate gaps SBC. Emera discloses the expense only by plan in Note 32 of its financial statements. A single override value fills every untagged year, so the latest filed year (FY2025, C$89M) is used for all years: it overstates FY2024 (disclosed total C$52M = ECSPP C$4M + options C$2M + DSU C$13M + PSU C$18M + RSU C$15M), i.e. it errs in the conservative direction (more SBC = lower owner's earnings), and the amount is immaterial against the deeply negative OE base either way.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 4.1%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency CAD converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 40-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Emera Inc. Form 40-F / FY2025 reporting: the Corporation's common shares are listed directly on the TSX and NYSE under the symbol EMA (every earnings release header reads TSX/NYSE: EMA); there is no depositary or ADS program — the NYSE line is the same common shares. The FY2025 statements' EPS note (Note 13) denominator — weighted average diluted shares 299.7M — matches the engine's shares_diluted_latest exactly, confirming filed per-share figures and the NYSE price are on the same share basis.) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Utilities sector — OE/capex DCF fits utilities names poorly; grade confidence low

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:sbc — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Emera Inc. FY2025 consolidated financial statements (filed as Exhibit 99.3 to the Form 40-F for the year ended Dec 31, 2025, filed 2026-02-23, accession 0001193125-26-062876), Note 32 Stock-Based Compensation: compensation cost recognized FY2025 — ECSPP C$3M + stock options C$3M + employee/director DSUs C$29M + PSU plan C$31M + RSU plan C$23M = C$89M (CAD, as filed; the engine FX-converts at period-end rates).); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
note: No positive NORMALIZED (3-yr median) conservative owner's earnings — OE DCF not supportable on numbers alone. If the latest year alone is positive, that is a flag to investigate, not a pass. F sub-type: no cash generation (OCF - capex is not positive).

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
